root.label: WA police issue Land Forces exclusion orders and activists threaten review

events.label: WA police issue Land Forces exclusion orders and activists threaten review

slots.name: excluded people
slots.sentence: Activists and a Greens MP have threatened legal action after the Western Australia police banned at least 12 people entering a designated security area where the Land Forces weapons expo will be held in Perth from 6 October.

slots.name: fine amount
slots.sentence: Lane-Rose was fined $2,000 last year after pleading guilty with other Disrupt Burrup Hub activists to attempted trespass and criminal damage at the home of the then Woodside boss, Meg O’Neill, in 2023.

slots.name: exclusion list status
slots.sentence: Rose told reporters the police called her on Thursday saying she had been placed on the exclusion list, despite having no plans to attend the protest against the expo, which is being organised by the WA Anti-War Collective.

slots.name: previous event date
slots.sentence: The last event was held in 2024 in Melbourne, and attracted a large protest where police were accused of using excessive force.
